notes: Run only one level at a time and require human approval before the next level.
Use overload_rejections.py on the final candidate for heavy/global 50301 P99; zero ladder rejections do not satisfy that SLO.
CPU 80% and heap 65% stop before the OpenSearch search-backpressure defaults of 90% and 70% node duress.
Three consecutive non-zero queue samples at the default 2-second interval mean a sustained queue of about 6 seconds.
The 100-millisecond rejection SLO is end-to-end; the 10-millisecond semaphore wait is only a candidate internal budget.
A light-request P95 more than twice its standalone baseline requires workload isolation or an explicitly approved SLO.
